companyInfo.description: QQQ tracks the Nasdaq-100 Index, representing the top 100 non-financial tech and growth giants. As a global synonym for tech innovation, it is a core tool for investors capturing growth in tech, biotech, and consumer services.
companyInfo.descriptionZh: QQQ是一只追踪纳斯达克100指数的明星基金。它包含了纳斯达克市值最大的100家非金融公司（主要是科技、生物医药和消费巨头）。作为全球科技创新的代名词，QQQ是投资者捕捉科技巨头成长红利、进行流动性管理的核心工具。
